cases.title: Bright River Solar
cases.tagline: A 50 MWp solar plant in Vietnam. The sponsor wants a term sheet by Friday.
cases.intro: A 50 MWp solar plant in Ninh Thuan, Vietnam. The sponsor is asking for a USD 28.5m senior loan.

cases.title: Amihan Wind
cases.tagline: A 60 MW wind farm in Luzon. A listed sponsor, a 12-year PPA and an 18-year loan request.
cases.intro: A 60 MW onshore wind farm in Luzon, Philippines. The sponsor is asking for a USD 69.75m senior loan.
